Latest report The Marketing Measurement Gap ↓ October 5, 2026
The headline finding
More than 4 in 10 audited websites had no observable Google Analytics.
51 no observable Google Analytics
69 the other websites audited
Each square is one audited website. Each row of 12 is one tenth of the sample. The 69 plain squares are every other website audited, as described in the finding.
Among the 120 websites audited, Google Analytics was not observed on 51 (42.5%) and was observable on 67 (55.8%). Two websites were classified as Unable to Determine.
What this means for you
If your website can’t see where visitors come from, it’s hard to tell which marketing brings enquiries.
What it doesn’t mean
It doesn’t mean these businesses had no measurement at all. Some may use tools that can’t be seen from outside.
n=120 Indian business websites · MSR-001 Audit Protocol v1.1. Publicly observable infrastructure only.
